title: Nova Solvaris Server Modpack
description: Client-side ModPack made for the Nova Solvaris Minecraft Server.
body:
# **Nova Solvaris Mod Pack** Performance‑boosted and QoL modpack for the Nova Solvaris server. ### **Overview** The Nova Solvaris is a client sided modpack mostly used for the purpose of playing on the Nova Solvaris Server. The pack focuses on these these main features: ## **Main Features:** ⚡ Huge increase of fps and performance using mods like [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) 🎨 Optifine-like resource pack features which are highly needed by server resource packs. 🎨 Shader support using [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) 🧭 QoL (Quality of Life) features such as minimaps. 🧱 Builder utilities in a form of [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) 🔒 Increased Freedom of speech mods such as [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports) and [No Chat Restrictions](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-restrictions). 🎵 Inclusion of some cosmetic mods such as [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers), [Capes](https://modrinth.com/mod/capes) and [Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential). So you dont lose your custom cosmetics by installing the modpack while your player model also looks nicer. 🛠️ Being all client sided meaning supporting unmodded enviroment with little to no issues. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## **Where do i join the community and report bugs?** 👥 You can join our discord community server by pressing the button [here](https://discord.gg/5YwVUznDEu) 🛠️ The discord server is also used for any bugs regarding to the modpack since the modpack was made for the server. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## **Known Bugs** 🐛 Custom Server-Sided Entities do not display how much damage they have taken. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## **ModPack License** **Feel free to use the modpack as a base for your own modpacks if you wish to do so.**
